soldier: Head of the soldier brown tinged with red, nasus reddish brown, thoracic and abdominal tergites pale brown, the anterior half of the pronotum dark brown, legs pale yellow. Surface of the head sparsely covered with short fine hairs, short hairs at the tip of the nasus, the anterior margin of the pronotum with a row of short hairs, the abdominal tergites with a number of short hairs interspersed with four longitudinal rows of long hairs. Pronotum saddle-shaped, more than twice as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins both straight at the middle. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2.
